name: Month-view board
used_for: The calendar's home view — a month you can read at a glance
Selecting a day to drive the agenda list (CAL-004)
Month navigation via prev/next chevrons
visual_description: A full month on black ground: serif month title with chrome-purple chevron buttons, serif weekday header row, 7-column grid of dark day cells with 1.5px white-lit edges. Today (16th) wears a 2px gold edge with gold glow and a slow breathe; event pills in wheel order (purple, blue, gold on today); overflow days show jewel dots plus an honest "+2 more" chip; out-of-month days sit at 34% opacity.

name: Event card
used_for: The atomic event object — one event, fully dressed
Cards inside the agenda timeline (CAL-004)
All-day, multi-day, and tentative events with honest styling
visual_description: One event fully dressed: a serif time rail on the left, a 3px glowing spine in the event's fixed spectrum color, a letterspaced type tag in that color, a serif title, and a location/attendees row with drawn SVG glyphs. Hover lifts 6px and ignites the border in the event's own color. Variants: all-day (rail collapses to a glowing band), multi-day span (rail carries the range with an honesty note), tentative (dashed edge, tilde time).

name: Date picker
used_for: Choosing a single calendar date inside forms
Date input where past dates must be visibly and truly unavailable
Keyboard-operable date selection
visual_description: An input-styled black trigger (drawn calendar glyph, "Choose a date" placeholder) that opens an elevated mini month panel: serif month title, 7-column grid of 36px day buttons, today in gold, chosen day held in chrome-purple, past dates at 32% opacity with strikethrough and fully inert (disabled, out of tab order). Full keyboard contract: arrows move, Enter chooses, Esc closes. A footnote states calendar-date-only, no timezone assumed.

name: Agenda list
used_for: The day view — what is happening, in order
The target of CAL-001's +N more chip and day selection
Honest empty days
visual_description: The day's events as a vertical timeline: serif time gutter, a glowing 3px spectrum spine per event in its fixed type color, a rotated-diamond node jewel at each junction, and cards in the CAL-002 language (tag, serif title, one meta line). A gold now-line with a "now" flag marks the present — rendered only when viewing today. The empty state centers a gold jewel over serif "Nothing scheduled" and "The day is yours."

name: Day-cell state system
used_for: The single source of truth for day-cell states across the calendar family
Teaching states statically — builders implement without running a demo
Precedence disputes (today beats selected, always)
visual_description: The seven honest states of a calendar day frozen as static specimens with labels: rest, hover (lift + chrome-purple), selected (held purple), today (gold edge + breathe, outranks selection), has-events (jewel dots in wheel order), disabled (32% opacity, struck, inert), out-of-month (34% opacity, click jumps month). One class per state with a written precedence order so CAL-001 and CAL-003 never drift.

name: Order summary board
used_for: The pre-payment "here is what you're paying for" surface in any checkout flow
Cart review before the payment form
Anywhere a total must be stated with tabular figures and an honest price promise
variants: hover (board lifts 5px, ignites purple; items lift 2px in own jewel color; total ignites gold)
visual_description: A deep-black board (24px radius, 5-layer shadow, purple tone spine, corner jewel) holding line items — each with a rotated-diamond thumb jewel in its own spectrum color, name, qty stepper, and right-aligned price — above a promo-code row, subtotal/estimated-tax rows, and a Georgia-serif grand total that ignites gold on hover. Honest microcopy: "Prices confirmed at checkout."

name: Payment form
used_for: Capturing card details bound for the payment processor
Any card-entry surface that must obey the privacy boundary: card data lives only in the inputs, the display layer shows at most last-4 plus brand
variants: invalid (red edge + plain-words message, never blames the user)
empty (blank form is rest, not error)
visual_description: A black board with four floating-label fields (name, card number, expiry, CVC) — white-lit 1.5px edges at rest, purple ignition on focus, emerald edge when valid, red edge with a plain-words helping sentence when invalid. A brand jewel orb lights in the card brand's own color on recognition. The Pay button (one per view, 56px) carries the real total and stays disabled until the form validates.

name: Confirmation state
used_for: The post-payment "it worked" surface
Receipt presentation with honest sent-vs-pending truth states
Any confirmed-transaction moment that needs restraint: one ignition, then breathe
variants: ignited (.is-ignited: one 1.1s flare on confirmed success)
receipt pending (gold ?, claimed awaiting its stamp)
receipt-email-failed (charged ✓, retrying — never reads as payment failure)
visual_description: An emerald-tone success board: the paid amount as a 56px Georgia hologram number (four layered shadows, slow breathe) that fires exactly one ignition when the processor confirms, then settles. Receipt rows (what/when/receipt) with law-order jewel bullets; the receipt line is emerald ✓ only when the backend confirms delivery, gold ? while claimed and pending. One primary action and one quiet action.

name: Error state
used_for: Declined or failed payments — the honest, calm, actionable failure surface
Processor timeouts and expired sessions (headline and cause line change; "no money moved" only when confirmed)
Any payment failure where retry needs explicit consent
variants: declined / processor-failed / session-expired (named cause, always "no money moved" when confirmed)
charge-state-unknown ("Check status" instead of "Try again" — never guesses)
visual_description: A red-tone board breathing on a slow 6s loop — urgency, not alarm: red edge and glow, never a flood, never flashing. Plain-words headline ("That didn't go through") with "no money moved" in the first line, three concrete next-steps with jewel bullets, a small monospace reference code for the bank call, and "Try again" as the chrome-purple primary action. role="alert".

name: Payment method picker
used_for: The "which card?" step for accounts with saved payment methods
Anywhere a stored-method choice must obey the privacy boundary: last-4 plus brand only, exactly as the backend returns masked
variants: hover (row lifts 2px, ignites purple; new-card row's → nudges)
selected (.is-selected: purple edge, wash, glow, check orb)
empty (no saved methods: the new-card row becomes the whole picker, pre-highlighted)
visual_description: Saved cards as full-row radio labels: brand jewel orb in the brand's own color (Visa blue, Mastercard orange, Amex emerald), last-4 plus expiry, one gold "Default" chip. The selected row ignites purple — choosing intelligence — with a ✓ check orb fading in. A dashed "Use a new card" row hands off to PAY-002. Never shows full numbers.
